scenarioUsage: Catalog modelParams.scenario selects a scientific model. Controls visible on each catalog entry override defaults. scenarioControls documents scenario-specific inputs; energy/pendulum uses the actual RigidBody2D and PinJoint2D solver, not the static solve method.

measurement.note: Readings rounded to instrument division; corrected reading removes zero error. scenario selects units.

incline.note: Actual RigidBody2D solver. Ideal frictionless incline, right-to-left. mass in grams only for incline.

motion.note: Actual RigidBody2D solver; horizontal unless freefall. Ideal dry friction, no drag. uniform overrides force/friction to zero; collision uses static wall at distance.

sound.note: Ideal sinusoidal acoustic signal; amplitude and loudness indices are relative, not measured dB. Sound speeds are approximate at room temperature.

thermal.note: No heat loss; heating temperatures bounded by boiling only in phase model, not general thermal. mixing same material unless capacity2 supplied.

phase.note: Water/ice enthalpy model with phase plateaus at 0C and pressure-dependent boiling point. Evaporation/sublimation are qualitative tendency models, not measured rate.

density.note: density g/cm3 and kg/m3; displacement volume equals immersed nonporous body volume.

optics.note: Angles measured from normal. Snell law including total internal reflection; mirror plane and pinhole straight rays.

lens.note: Thin lens equation, focal distance positive convex negative concave. Real/virtual image and magnification correctly signed.

force.note: Static force resultants, not fabricated experimental deformation; spring model quantifies elasticity.

spring.note: Hooke law only within stated elastic limit; outside model returns validity warning, not extrapolated elastic result.

pressure.note: Hydrostatic gauge pressure rho g h; simplified incompressible Bernoulli and standard atmosphere assumptions specified.

buoyancy.note: Archimedes displaced-volume model; floating equilibrium submerged fraction only when object density <= liquid density.

lever.note: Torques use perpendicular moment arms, not necessarily rod lengths.

pulley.note: Ideal massless pulley for fixed/movable or stated efficiency for block; rope distance n*h, pull load/(n*eta).

work.note: Work F*s*cos(theta); efficiency only when total positive and useful<=total.

energy.note: Energy state solver; no loss. Motion animations requiring trajectories use motion/incline engine models.

molecular.note: Qualitative dimensionless diffusion/interaction trends; no invented real molecular measurements.

charge.note: Electrostatic qualitative relative model; electroscope angle is illustrative, cannot measure charge quantitatively.

circuit.note: DC ideal source and ohmic resistors. Lamp fixed rated resistance approximation explicitly noted; short circuit uses explicit internalResistance default0.5ohm.

joule.note: Joule heat I^2 R t; assumes constant resistance and all electrical energy becomes heat.

household.note: Residential energy and current calculation; safety scenarios qualitative, simulation only.

magnet.note: Relative solenoid field and torque, not calibrated force; sign controls polarity and motor torque direction.

induction.note: Induced emf for straight conductor B*l*v*sin(theta), or sinusoidal rotating-coil conceptual model.

emwave.note: Vacuum electromagnetic speed c; lambda=c/f with MHz conversion.
